contract.declaration: Optional graph.step compensate: registered cleanup job declaring agent.idempotent=true with synchronous typed mapper, or bounded explicit manual reason
contract.identity: Typed input/run/step/original-job identities, stable provider operation key and discriminated succeeded result versus uncertain failed/cancelled attempted effect
contract.trigger: Failure, cancellation, denied/timed-out waits and output failure cancel/wait for forward children; never-attempted steps skip cleanup
contract.order: One cleanup job per run in deterministic reverse dependency order; successful runs never compensate and report not-needed
contract.inventory: Original failed/cancelled outcome retained beside separate recovery progress and ordered bounded step/job/result/error evidence
contract.manual: Irreversible declaration, exhausted/cancelled cleanup, malformed mapper or changed/missing definition records visible manual intervention and stops automatic upstream cleanup
contract.fences: Same-transaction occurrence, owner, current definition/protocol, stable key, frozen payload and active lease checks before claim/handler/SQLite effects and successful settlement
contract.retention: Routine job/workflow purge protects unresolved recovery and referenced forward/cleanup jobs; operator retry cannot reset retained attempts. Explicit inactive manual-evidence purge still refuses active jobs
contract.authorization: Original owner scope preserved; application independently checks current access on uncached progress requests and current business/provider permission in handlers; no anonymous operator endpoint or new approval authority

limits.cleanupErrorBytes: Existing configured job error limit; explicit manual reasons have their own bounded declaration limit

migration.legacy: Exact pre-compensation graph revision d2c2d017ac196bbb retained with no recovery tables for ordinary graphs
migration.capacity: Additive private state/run/step tables reserve capacity atomically with run/jobs before a future failure
migration.definition: Forward/cleanup handler source, cleanup schema/mapper and manual reason participate only for compensation graphs; changed/missing retained definitions fail into manual evidence
migration.configuration: Function source cannot capture mutable external configuration; use pure mappers and versioned validated input, identical fleet definition/configuration
migration.rollback: Older workers ignore this contract; use a verified compatible binary/database/configuration snapshot
migration.purge: Retained completed recovery can be removed with terminal run; deleting inactive manual evidence is an explicit trusted-operator choice, never an active-job override
